root_cause: Incomplete file-size-limit enforcement across multer upload routes (CWE-770)

v1.ref: ghcr.io/danny-avila/librechat:v0.7.6 (CVE-2024-11171 fix bb58a2d0: avatar/file limits; /api/convos/import unguarded)

v2.ref: ghcr.io/danny-avila/librechat:v0.8.4-rc1 (CVE-2026-54024 fix: multer limits:{fileSize} + 413 on import)

flag.resource: file-size acceptance threshold (DoS-threshold oracle, Variant C: no planted token)
flag.detect: seed: HTTP 200 {url} vs 500 on avatar upload; residual: HTTP 201 vs 413 on convos import

notes: CVE-2024-11171: multer in-memory uploads had no size limit -> OOM DoS; fixed 0.7.6 (commit bb58a2d0662e) by moving avatar upload off in-memory multer and enforcing filterFile() avatarSizeLimit (2MB default) on /api/files/images/avatar. Residual CVE-2026-54024: POST /api/convos/import stayed on multer({storage,fileFilter}) with NO limits:{fileSize} from 0.7.6 through 0.8.3; fixed 0.8.4-rc1 by resolveImportMaxFileSize() (default 250MiB, env CONVERSATION_IMPORT_MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) + multer limits + handleUpload returning 413 on LIMIT_FILE_SIZE. PoC: register/login (JWT), then seed = 6MB PNG to /api/files/images/avatar (v0 200 {url}, v1 500 'An error occurred while uploading the profile picture'); residual = 6MB conversation-export JSON to /api/convos/import (v1 201 'Conversation(s) imported successfully', v2 413 'File exceeds the maximum allowed size'). Gate env sets CONVERSATION_IMPORT_MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES=5242880 on v2 only. Built 2026-08-01.
